name: Public informational menu transport boundary with explicit publication selection
identifierOrigin: OWNER-DIRECTED POST-FOOD-004A FORMALIZATION; identifier/title newly established by owner after FOOD-004A closure.
scope: Framework-neutral TRANSPORT consuming FOOD-004A only. Transport, service, selector, route, page, deployment, price publication and orderability remain separate. Actual route wiring and production reference selection are later separately authorized work.

contract.construction: Synchronous I/O-free factory captures selector.select and service.readPublicMenu with original receivers; returns frozen handle only. Missing callable dependencies throw fixed configuration TypeError. No environment/auth/repository acquisition.
contract.request: Only own method:string property. Exact GET and HEAD accepted, other methods 405 before selector/service. Malformed/extra request fields 400 before collaborators; never access their values or parse body/query/URL/header/cookie. Caller cannot select publication.
contract.selector: Trusted synchronous I/O-free select(): exact {publicationId,version} or null for unavailable. Validate strict own keys with canonical ID/version parsers; copy/freeze reference before single service invocation. Malformed, asynchronous or throwing selector maps to 503; no latest/current/history/fallback logic.
contract.mapping: found 200; invalid-input 400 invalid-request; not-found and not-published identical 404 menu-not-found; unavailable or unexpected collaborator/envelope/serialization failure 503 menu-unavailable; unsupported method 405 method-not-allowed.
contract.response: Frozen plain {status,headers,body?}; JSON.stringify canonical FOOD-004A menu only on GET success. Stable canonical projector insertion order preserved, no pretty printing/newline. Fixed GET failures serialize {error:code}. Serialized strings detach response from collaborator state. HEAD runs equivalent selection/read and returns identical status/headers for canonical service outcomes, without serializing or returning a body on any outcome. No added identity beyond existing canonical public projection.
contract.authority: Injected service must be canonical FOOD-004A; validate service envelope keys but do not duplicate projection/domain validation, resolve dependencies, add public fields or invoke projector directly. Canonical service is public payload allowlist authority, not an arbitrary untrusted payload callback.
contract.headers: Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8 on GET and equivalent HEAD; Allow GET, HEAD on 405 only. No cache policy, CORS, ETag, Last-Modified or security-header framework. Private no-store precedent is specific to private mutation and does not impose a public caching policy.
contract.lifetime: No cross-request caches or retained request/selector results. Capture method before await; selector reference copied before service invocation. Unexpected request property access safely maps to 400; injected selector/service failures contained as fixed 503 following sanitized FOOD-004A convention. Factory programming misconfiguration remains explicit TypeError.

exclusions: No route/UI/runtime activation, production publication/menu/recipe data, price/orderability/cart/order/payment, auth/session/CSRF, config/bindings/secrets, Cloudflare/D1/KV/migrations/deployment, existing source changes, staging/commit/push.
validation: Focused transport and unchanged FOOD-004A tests
Full FOOD suite including FOOD-002 projector/persistence/private boundaries
